name: intelligent-delegate
description: Routes a task to the cheapest execution shape that still gets it right — inline, a single subagent, or a Workflow fan-out — and picks the model tier and reasoning effort to match. Ships seven pre-tiered agent definitions so effort is actually reachable from the Agent tool, including a pinned-Sonnet rung (drafter, inspector) that makes per-stage downgrading possible in an Opus session, plus a PreToolUse hook that blocks a Workflow whose agent() calls carry no agentType.
